title: Bicoloured-interval and interval-sandwich graphs: two new classes in the tolerance hierarchy
summary: We introduce two new graph classes, the bicoloured-interval graphs and the interval-sandwich graphs, arising from the study of the robust line fitting problem in computer vision. In a bicoloured-interval graph, each vertex is assigned a real interval and one of two colours. Vertices of different colours are adjacent precisely when their intervals intersect, and vertices of the same colour precisely when the centre of one interval lies in the other.
